heuristics.name: material-and-mobility
heuristics.plan: Win material, and keep your options open.

heuristics.name: Hill Runner
heuristics.plan: March your king toward d4/e4/d5/e5 as fast as possible, trading pieces off to clear the path rather than hoarding them.

heuristics.name: Classical Material Grinder
heuristics.plan: Ignore the hill and just win pieces, keeping your own king safe and far from the middle.

heuristics.name: Central Clamp
heuristics.plan: Occupy and control the four central squares with pieces so the enemy king can never step in, then squeeze.

heuristics.name: Mating Attack
heuristics.plan: Throw everything at the enemy king with checks and threats, aiming for checkmate before hill or material matters.

heuristics.name: Pawn Storm and Promote
heuristics.plan: Push your pawns down the board and promote them to queens, using the new material to overwhelm both king and centre.
